risk_row_2_status: Risk row 2 recorded the filter's exact mechanics as OPEN, SCRIPT UNREAD. The script is now read. It is 86 lines.
headline: THE q05 POWER-LAW FILTER DOES NOT SELECT ON MOMENTUM. It selects on VOLUME, conditional on momentum. The momentum threshold is upstream, in the scan files it reads, and the producer of those files is NOT in this repo.

what_it_actually_does.detail: reads two scan files - full_2020_2024_momentum_scan_20251122_000515.parquet and momentum_scan_2025.parquet - and concatenates them
drops rows with null momentum_pct or event_volume, and requires event_volume > 0 and momentum_pct > 0
training set = events at or below the 99.5th percentile of momentum_pct
fits QUANTILE REGRESSION at q=0.05 of log_vol on log_mom (statsmodels quantreg)
predicts a per-event log-volume threshold from that fitted line, for ALL valid events including the high-momentum tail excluded from training
KEEPS events where log_vol > log_vol_threshold - volume above the 5th-percentile volume line for that event's momentum
writes filtered_events_power_law_q05.parquet and a CSV backup

three_properties_that_make_it_non_reprod.detail: The cutoff is a quantile line FITTED OVER THE POOLED 2020-2025 POPULATION (line 42-43). Membership is therefore not a property of an event; it depends on every other event in the file. This is stronger than the open item's current wording, 'the selection variable is only knowable after the session ends' - the threshold is knowable only after the entire multi-year population is assembled.
three_properties_that_make_it_non_reprod.consequence: No real-time screen can reproduce archive membership even in principle, because the threshold does not exist until the population does.

three_properties_that_make_it_non_reprod.detail: event_volume is one of the spine numeric columns D4 permanently quarantines from computation, and D4 Amendment A9.2 extends that quarantine to pre-ingestion candidate_scan_inputs files prospectively. The universe's own selection function ran on that column, before the quarantine existed.
three_properties_that_make_it_non_reprod.consequence: Recorded, not actionable here - A9.2 is prospective and the universe is frozen. Stated so that no future work treats archive membership as a D4-clean quantity.

three_properties_that_make_it_non_reprod.detail: event_volume is a whole-session total and is unknowable at any intraday decision time.
